# Super Simple

> Super Simple creates engaging educational content for children through animated series, songs, and interactive resources using TPR (Total Physical Response) methodology.

Super Simple is a platform founded by Caitie and Tobee that produces high-quality kids' educational entertainment including songs, animated shows, and downloadable learning materials like worksheets, crafts, and flashcards. The content is designed for early childhood education and language learning.

## Key Topics

- Super Simple Songs
- Educational content
- Kids entertainment
- Animated series
- TPR (Total Physical Response)
- Worksheets and crafts
- Nursery rhymes
- Phonics and alphabet learning
- Interactive games
- Flashcards
- Caitie
- Tobee
- Episode guides
- Children's education
- Music and movement activities

## Flagship Programs

- [Super Simple Songs](https://supersimple.com/super-simple-songs): Main Super Simple Songs product page with nursery rhymes and TPR-based music videos
- [Caitie's Classroom](https://supersimple.com/caities-classroom): Caitie's Classroom interactive show with sing-alongs, crafts, and themed lessons
- [Move With Caitie](https://supersimple.com/move-with-caitie): Move With Caitie dance and movement videos for kids with music activities

## Animated Series

- [The Bumble Nums](https://supersimple.com/the-bumble-nums): The Bumble Nums animated series with episodes, worksheets, crafts, and songs
- [Captain Seasalt & The ABC Pirates](https://supersimple.com/captain-seasalt-and-the-abc-pirates): Captain Seasalt & The ABC Pirates series for alphabet learning with pirate theme
- [Carl's Car Wash](https://supersimple.com/carls-car-wash): Carl's Car Wash animated series with episodes, crafts, and coloring activities
- [Finny The Shark](https://supersimple.com/finny-the-shark): Finny The Shark animated series with episodes, worksheets, games, and flashcards
- [Imagination Time](https://supersimple.com/imagination-time): Imagination Time animated story series with worksheets, coloring, and craft activities
- [Mr. Monkey, Monkey Mechanic](https://supersimple.com/mr-monkey-monkey-mechanic): Mr. Monkey animated series with character episodes, crafts, and educational content

## Learning & Literacy Programs

- [Phonics Fun](https://supersimple.com/phonics-fun): Phonics Fun with alphabet songs, flashcards, worksheets, and interactive games
- [Pratfall](https://supersimple.com/pratfall): Pratfall alphabet series focusing on lowercase letter learning through episodes

## Educational Shows

- [Milo's Monster School Vlog](https://supersimple.com/milos-monster-school-vlog): Milo's Monster School Vlog educational series covering elementary subjects

## Teaching Resources & Guides

- [How To Teach Super Simple Songs](https://supersimple.com/how-to-teach-super-simple-songs): Guide for teaching Super Simple Songs with classroom activities and methods
